title: Example Feedback Taxonomy {{new.label}}
subtitle: Synthetic example for the support and product teams that tag customer feedback
summary: Each record in the taxonomy is a tag that agents attach to customer feedback, and each record belongs to one category such as Billing. Version {{new.label}} merges **FB-007 Wrong invoice address** into **FB-006 Invoice error** and removes **FB-019 Fax support request**, which has no successor. It adds **FB-023 Refund delay**, **FB-024 Damaged packaging**, and **FB-025 Two-factor code not received**. Reports that count feedback by category will show different totals for Account, Product, and Support.

actions.what: From {{date}}, tag invoices with a wrong billing address as FB-006, and use FB-023, FB-024, and FB-025 for the three new cases. Check the latest delivery date shown at checkout before tagging FB-011 Late delivery.

Re-tag stored FB-007 feedback as FB-006, and re-tag stored FB-016 feedback that mentions a missing sign-in code as FB-025. Keep stored FB-019 tags as history, since the fax line is closed. Category totals change because FB-013 and FB-020 moved, FB-019 was removed, and FB-023, FB-024, and FB-025 were added.
Mark {{date}} on defect-rate trend charts, because FB-014 now counts only defects within the warranty period.
Handle FB-025 tickets, which the queue now routes to you.

figures.title: Records by kind of change
figures.caption: A new definition is the most common change, with {{field_changes.definition.major}} records.

figures.title: Records per category
figures.caption: Account goes from {{groups.Account.before}} to {{groups.Account.after}} because FB-020 moved in from Support and FB-025 was added. Support goes from {{groups.Support.before}} to {{groups.Support.after}} because FB-020 moved out and FB-019 was removed. Product goes from {{groups.Product.before}} to {{groups.Product.after}} because FB-013 moved in from Delivery. Delivery stays at {{groups.Delivery.after}}: FB-013 moved out and FB-024 was added. Billing stays at {{groups.Billing.after}}: FB-007 was merged into FB-006 and FB-023 was added.

changes.title: Wrong invoice address merged into FB-006 Invoice error
changes.why: Agents could not choose between the two records when an invoice had both a wrong address and a wrong amount.
changes.impact: New feedback goes to FB-006, whose definition now names the billing address. FB-006 has a more urgent queue priority than FB-007 had, and lower priority numbers are handled first.

changes.title: Slow shipping renamed Late delivery, with a date-based definition
changes.why: The old definition depended on what the customer expected. The new definition compares the arrival with the latest date shown at checkout, so two agents tag the same parcel the same way. Late deliveries now qualify for the same refund as lost parcels, so they get the same priority as **FB-008 Lost parcel**.
changes.impact: Agents check the delivery date shown at checkout before tagging. Late deliveries join the most urgent priority level.

figure.title: Records with a new priority
figure.caption: FB-002, FB-011, and FB-017 each move one level toward the front of the queue. Lower numbers are handled first.

changes.title: Defective product limited to the warranty period
changes.why: Agents tagged complaints about products used against their instructions here, so the reported defect rate was too high.
changes.impact: Expect fewer FB-014 tags from the release date on. Product teams tracking defect rates mark that date on their trend charts.

changes.title: Login problem renamed Sign-in failure and limited to correct credentials
changes.why: Missing two-factor codes now have their own record, FB-025. The new name matches the wording on the sign-in page.
changes.impact: Agents tag a missing code as FB-025 and keep FB-016 for failures with correct credentials. Report owners re-tag stored two-factor feedback.

changes.title: Two-factor code not received added
changes.why: Agents tagged missing two-factor codes as FB-016, but a different team fixes them.
changes.impact: The queue routes FB-025 to the identity team.

reasons.FB-004: Only card payments can be declined at checkout
reasons.FB-009: Wrong size or color was tagged inconsistently
reasons.FB-020: The account team handles data requests
reasons.FB-023: Refund delays were tagged as invoice errors
reasons.FB-024: Packaging damage was tagged as lost or wrong items

sections.heading: Compatibility of feedback exports
paragraphs: CSV exports of tagged feedback keep the same columns. Every record keeps its ID except FB-007 and FB-019, which no longer exist.

open_questions: Should FB-024 Damaged packaging move to Product when the product inside is also damaged?
